clips.send: A friend stuck on a stalled scale sends this to another friend who just about gave up on their diet because 'the number won't move' - relief, and a reason to keep going.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau gives a simple fix for anyone frustrated with a scale that won't move: stop weighing yourself and start taking pictures instead.

His method: four photos in your underwear or a bathing suit - front, back, both sides - taken in the same spot. Repeat it 30 days later and compare.

His reasoning: muscle weighs more than fat, so the scale can stay the same while your body actually changes underneath it. Looser clothes are the real signal, not the number.

Kevin Trudeau's rule: forget the scale, trust the mirror and the waistband.

When's the last time you measured progress by anything other than a number?

clips.send: Someone sends this to a friend who complains about bloating every night after dinner - practical relief, a tiny habit swap, not a big ask.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau shares the easiest version of a habit he says helped his digestion and his waistline: a cup of ginger tea.

His simple method: one 100% organic ginger tea bag, steeped in hot water for five to ten minutes. No chopping or boiling a pot of root for twenty minutes required.

His reasoning: ginger helps digestion, helps clear the sinuses, and in his view helps the body burn fat and stimulate metabolism, on top of its vitamin C and anti-inflammatory properties.

Kevin Trudeau's rule: keep it simple enough that you'll actually do it daily.

Would a cup of tea before bed replace something less healthy in your routine?
